findings.claim: The real-tree gitlink completeness gate silently passes when `git ls-tree -r HEAD` fails, allowing an incomplete `versions.toml` to be accepted.
findings.evidence: `listGitlinksFromGit` returns `[]` on any non-zero git status (`if (result.status !== 0) return [];`), while the spec requires the test to fail when a gitlink under `tools/` is not named and the constraints call out silent failure as a review target.
findings.suggested_fix: Throw an error on non-zero `git ls-tree` status, including stderr/status, instead of returning an empty list.
